target_customer: Sneakerheads buying and selling rare and limited edition sneakers on iPhone
problem: Selling rare sneakers on eBay or Instagram was slow and risky, with fakes and long waits.
business_model: Marketplace with a 10 percent commission on completed sales

founders.name: Kemar Newell
founders.background_notes: YC page and 2016 coverage name only him; no education or prior employers found in opened sources.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile marketplace with auctions and listings, plus an authentication and buyer protection process; mostly operations.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity of buyers and sellers helps, but eBay and later StockX and GOAT offered similar marketplaces and sneakers are easy to list elsewhere.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Complex reported in 2016 that GOAT launched in 2015 and StockX began beta in December 2015, so well funded rivals arrived within a year; what happened to Flip afterward is not found.

market_need_then: Complex in 2016 cited Campless data that eBay sneaker sales fell for the first time in January 2015, showing resale demand moving to new venues.

identity.voice_and_tone: Sneakerhead by sneakerheads, authenticity promise via Flip Protect

branding.brand_signature: 90 minute sell guarantee and the line eBay for the Snapchat generation
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Hypebeast, Complex and NYLON; founder appeared on Apple Music show Planet of the Apps.

brand_strength.rationale: Notable sneaker press and a TV appearance, but the name collides with other Flip companies and no evidence of lasting community.

outcome_analysis: Flip got YC backing, a Google director angel, press in 2016 and a Lightspeed investment after a TV appearance in 2017, but no source gives its later traction, funding size or fate. The directory marks it Active while the site returned a 503, so the outcome cannot be judged from public data found.
notes: Different companies named Flip exist (a social shopping app that raised 28M and 144M) and are not this one. CB Insights lists about 300K over 3 rounds, unverified aggregator. Hypebeast fetch returned empty and justflip.com returned 503. Google director angel in early backers per NYLON, amount unknown. Competitor sources found are dated 2016, too late, so the list is empty.
